## AdaptiveCurveConfig #3001

Admits a target utilization of exactly WAD.

- **Mutant:** [`3001.sol`](3001.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvIcfGetOrDeployAdaptiveRevertsIffParamsInvalid`](../../specs/IrmConfigFactory/IrmConfigFactory_properties.spec#L262)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh AdaptiveCurveConfig 3001`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmConfigFactory/properties.conf --rule rvIcfGetOrDeployAdaptiveRevertsIffParamsInvalid`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/AdaptiveCurveConfig.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/adaptive-curve-irm/AdaptiveCurveConfig.sol
@@ -70,7 +70,7 @@
         require(curveParams.adjustmentSpeed <= MAX_ADJUSTMENT_SPEED, ErrorsLib.INVALID_ADJUSTMENT_SPEED);

         require(curveParams.targetUtilization > 0, ErrorsLib.INVALID_TARGET_UTILIZATION);
-        require(curveParams.targetUtilization < WAD, ErrorsLib.INVALID_TARGET_UTILIZATION);
+        require(curveParams.targetUtilization <= WAD, ErrorsLib.INVALID_TARGET_UTILIZATION);

         require(curveParams.minRateAtTarget > 0, ErrorsLib.INVALID_RATE_BOUNDS);
         require(curveParams.maxRateAtTarget >= curveParams.minRateAtTarget, ErrorsLib.INVALID_RATE_BOUNDS);
```
